name: Powder Metallurgy & Ceramic Processing
summary: Covers making parts from powders: powder production, forming, sintering and densification of metals and ceramics.

topics.name: Powder production: atomisation, chemical reduction, milling and chemical synthesis
Powder characterisation: size distribution, morphology and flowability
Slurries, dispersion and rheology for ceramic forming
Forming: die pressing, cold isostatic pressing, slip casting, tape casting and extrusion
Sintering theory: driving forces, neck growth, densification stages and mechanisms
Pressure-assisted sintering: hot pressing, HIP and spark plasma sintering
Sol-gel processing and chemical routes to ceramics
Firing of traditional ceramics and glazes
Defects in powder-processed parts and their control
